notes.title: Update v0.9.75
notes.notes:
I updated the color of tiles to be more reflective of the dangers that surround, as well as the original.

I have also implemented the framework for leaderboards, so those should be coming soon.

Plans after the leaderboards are to focus on supporting the HTC Vive and better controller scheme for both the Vive and Rift.

Thanks all!
